idPolicy: PR4-R2-01…05 refine PR4-Fxx. Never renumber OD/PR3. Do not claim PR3-01…14 all closed.

findings.title: Approved changeset A must not execute B
findings.acceptance: After receipt verify, commit the immutable approvedChangeset object. Never re-fetch latest pinned by batchId. Distinct proposals are distinct changeset identities. Consume approval once against that exact object.

findings.title: User edit after last check must survive
findings.acceptance: Injection after recordBackup before the managed write is BATCH_CONFLICT. User bytes stay. Single-writer lock plus re-read at write, not another relocated hash check alone.

findings.title: Recovery must not pretend success
findings.acceptance: Hashless journals, user delete vs planned write, user create vs planned delete, and truncated neither-hash states BLOCK. File + journal + backups stay. recovered:true is not returned. Weak hashless auto-restore is gone.

findings.title: Checkpoint worktree identity and binary mid-history
findings.acceptance: MAIN_SNAPSHOT restore must not clobber BATCH_WORK. Binary mid-checkpoint 81 00 restores; it must not fall back to initial 80 00. Full restore plan is validated before the cursor moves.

findings.title: Negation/multi-constraint shadow intent refuses
findings.acceptance: 不要去掉阴影，只改圆角 must not drop shadow and must declare rule mode refuse. 不要改颜色，只去掉阴影 still drops shadow only.
